hints: Three separate jobs: parse, find x, print depth k. Write them as three functions; each is short.
findNode searches BOTH subtrees - this is a plain binary tree, not a BST, so there is no left/right shortcut.
printAtDepth(node, k): if k == 0 print node; otherwise recurse into both children with k - 1. Left before right gives left-to-right order.
title: PD Lab 10 Q2: nodes at depth k below x
